description: 22uF, 35V, radial aluminum electrolytic, 5x11mm body, 2mm lead spacing

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for UPJ1V220MDD (Nichicon), Mouser part 647-UPJ1V220MDD.

Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description states '35volts 22uF 5x11 20% 2LS' - '2LS' is 2mm lead spacing. Nichicon's own UPJ series datasheet (nichicon.co.jp/english/series_items/catalog_pdf/e-upj.pdf, fetched 2026-09-30) dimension tables list case sizes and part numbers for the 35V (1V) row starting at 100uF and do not print this smaller 22uF/35V size, so the lead spacing is taken from Mouser's supplier-stated parameters per docs/parts/sourcing-notes.md ('Body size and lead spacing come from the datasheet unless the supplier's parameters state them').

Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description states '35volts 22uF 5x11 20% 2LS' - '5x11' is a 5mm diameter x 11mm long case; see the leadSpacingMm evidence note for why this is read from the supplier's stated parameters rather than the series datasheet.

why: This board's Panasonic M-A (ECA) family - used for the 10uF, 100uF, 220uF and 470uF/35V lines - does not offer 22uF at 35V in its printed dimension table (the 35V column jumps from 10uF to 47uF; Nichicon's UPJ series datasheet has the same gap at 35V, jumping from nothing below 100uF). Nichicon UPJ1V220MDD is Mouser-stocked (915 units, 2026-09-30) and its own listing states the exact case (5x11mm) and lead spacing (2mm) this line's footprint needs at exactly 35V, so no voltage margin beyond the line's minimum was spent.
